text:
Can't help with that one. Writing an ESP overlay or recoil control for use on live multiplayer servers is cheating against real players, and that's a line I don't cross regardless of framing.

If you're interested in related technical territory I'm actually happy to dig into — rendering/overlay systems, memory reading for educational purposes in a controlled context, or game development work on your own project — I'm here for that.
